description: Robustness TEST set (15): written after the fixes were finished and never used to change the system. 6 should be refused (chit-chat, data not held, authorship); 9 are in-scope questions in everyday wording, including 'should I...' questions that must be answered with facts only and two-item comparisons.

queries.question: what is the average income of a farmer in Car Nicobar?
should I grow ginger in Diglipur?
how has tomato been priced over the past two years
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.period_label, MIN(o.value), MAX(o.value) FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='retail_price' AND o.commodity_id='tomato' AND o.location_id='MKT_AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL AND o.period_start>='2024-01-01' AND o.period_start<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.period_label ORDER BY MIN(o.period_start)

queries.question: is coconut area in the UT going up?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.period_label, MIN(o.value), MAX(o.value) FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='area_cultivated' AND o.commodity_id='coconut' AND o.location_id='AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.period_label ORDER BY MIN(o.period_start)

queries.question: how many farmers live on Baratang?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.document_id, o.page, o.value FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='farmers_count' AND o.commodity_id IS NULL AND o.location_id='ISL_BARATANG' AND o.period_label='2024-25' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL

queries.question: potato vs onion price in March 2025
paddy yield in andaman
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.document_id, o.page, o.value FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='yield' AND o.commodity_id='paddy' AND o.location_id='AN' AND o.period_label='2023-24' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL

queries.question: which zone harvested the most banana in 2025-26?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.location_id, MAX(o.value) FROM observation o JOIN location l ON l.location_id=o.location_id WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='banana' AND l.level='agri_zone' AND o.period_label='2025-26' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.location_id ORDER BY 2 DESC

queries.question: give me the source for South Andaman's 2024-25 coconut area
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.document_id, o.page, o.value FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='area_cultivated' AND o.commodity_id='coconut' AND o.location_id='AN_SA' AND o.period_label='2024-25' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL
